obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the systemic risk buffer with the regulation's formula on every level of consolidation
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Süsteemse riski puhvri arvutamise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 02.06.2021 määrus nr 9, RT I, 09.06.2021, 2), § 2 ja § 3 lg 1, consolidated text RT I, 03.12.2021, 6, in force from 06.12.2021

titles.en: Calculate the systemic risk buffer with the regulation's formula on every level of consolidation

summaries.en: A credit institution licensed in Estonia calculates, individually and on a sub-consolidated and a consolidated basis, the own funds it holds as systemic risk buffer: the rate set for its total risk exposure times that exposure, plus, for each subset of exposures the Credit Institutions Act names, the rate set for that subset times the exposures in it. Each exposure amount is computed under Article 92(3) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the higher of Eesti Pank's and the ECB's systemic risk buffer rate from the day the requirement takes effect
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Süsteemse riski puhvri arvutamise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 02.06.2021 määrus nr 9, RT I, 09.06.2021, 2), § 3 lg 2 ja 3, consolidated text RT I, 03.12.2021, 6, in force from 06.12.2021

titles.en: Apply the higher of Eesti Pank's and the ECB's systemic risk buffer rate from the day the requirement takes effect

summaries.en: For each relevant set of exposures the institution uses the systemic risk buffer rate set by Eesti Pank or the one the European Central Bank set under Article 5(2) of Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013, whichever is higher, and counts it from the date the requirement enters into force. Where no rate has been set, the buffer is zero.

titles.en: Report investment services to Finantsinspektsioon every month by the tenth bank day

summaries.en: Every credit institution operating in Estonia, branches of foreign ones included, draws up the investment services report (code 246) in annex 3 for each calendar month and submits it to Finantsinspektsioon by the tenth bank day after the month ends. Clients are classified under the European system of accounts and instruments as Eesti Pank's supplementary balance sheet reporting regulation defines them.

summaries.en: The report goes to Finantsinspektsioon electronically as an XML document under Eesti Pank's regulation on electronic reporting, with currency codes under ISO 4217 and country codes under ISO 3166-1 in capitals. On finding an error or changing its accounting policies the institution submits a corrected report, and it submits an empty report when it has no data to report.

obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksebilansi koostamiseks vajalike andmete esitamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 22.10.2013 määrus nr 7, RT I, 25.10.2013, 1), § 2, § 4 lg 1, § 5 ja § 6, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 7, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Report residents' cross-border and non-residents' domestic payments of 10,000 euros or more to Eesti Pank every month by the seventh bank day

summaries.en: Every credit institution operating in Estonia, branches included, reports for the payment services provided in its Estonian units the cross-border payments of residents (code 227) and the domestic payments of non-residents (code 228) on the regulation's annexes, counting each payment of 10,000 euros or more or the equivalent in another currency. The period is a calendar month and the reports are due by the seventh bank day after it ends.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Classify payments as domestic or cross-border by the providers' location and leave out pass-through and returned payments
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksebilansi koostamiseks vajalike andmete esitamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 22.10.2013 määrus nr 7, RT I, 25.10.2013, 1), § 3 lg 2 ja 3 ja § 4 lg 2–6, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 7, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Classify payments as domestic or cross-border by the providers' location and leave out pass-through and returned payments

summaries.en: A payment is domestic when both the payer's and the payee's provider are in Estonia and cross-border when either is outside it, whatever the currency; a payment between clients of the same institution counts as domestic and a group account as a notional account. The reports leave out payments passing through intermediary or correspondent accounts between other institutions and payments returned to the payer for missing details.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the payment reports in XML, file empty reports when there is no data and keep them for one year
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksebilansi koostamiseks vajalike andmete esitamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 22.10.2013 määrus nr 7, RT I, 25.10.2013, 1), § 7 lg 1 ja 3 ja § 8, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 7, in force from 02.03.2026

summaries.en: The reports go to Eesti Pank electronically as XML documents under Eesti Pank's regulation on electronic reporting, with an empty report where there is no data. The institution keeps the reports it has submitted for one year.

It follows the regulation and the requirements the European Banking Authority publishes on its website, and sends the reports to the address fiaruanded@fi.ee.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use ISO codes, business register codes and the set precision in the supervisory reports
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pangandusmääruse alusel kehtestatud järelevalveliste aruannete edastamise vorm (Eesti Panga presidendi 02.07.2014 määrus nr 11, RT I, 03.07.2014, 40), § 6 ja § 8 lg 1 ja 2, consolidated text RT I, 28.05.2021, 2, in force from 28.06.2021

titles.en: Use ISO codes, business register codes and the set precision in the supervisory reports

summaries.en: Currency codes follow ISO 4217 and country codes ISO 3166, in capitals, and the institution, holding company, counterparty or connected persons are identified by their business register code unless the reporting standard requires otherwise, or else by an identifier the institution assigns, with no <, >, &, apostrophe or quotation mark in identifiers or text. Amounts are given in whole euros or to the cent, and percentages as i/100 rounded to four decimals.

titles.en: Report operational risk losses and incidents, key risk indicators and lawsuits to Finantsinspektsioon every quarter

summaries.en: Every credit institution operating in Estonia draws up the operational risk loss and incident report (code 672), the key risk indicators report (673) and the lawsuits report (674) on the annexes for each quarter and submits them to Finantsinspektsioon within the month after the quarter ends. A parent, or a subsidiary of a financial or mixed financial holding company acting as parent in Estonia, reports on a consolidated basis only; any other institution reports on a solo basis only.

titles.en: Prepare the operational risk reports in Estonian and in whole euros as at the end of the quarter

summaries.en: The reports are written in Estonian, amounts are in euros rounded to whole units, foreign currency amounts are converted at the ECB rate of the period's last bank day and data are given as at the end of the period unless the regulation says otherwise. Country codes follow ISO 3166-1 in capitals and dates ISO 8601-1.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply for an Eesti Pank account on its form with proof of legal status, powers and ownership
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste kontode avamise ja kasutamise tingimused Eesti Pangas (Eesti Panga presidendi 22.09.2022 määrus nr 7, RT I, 24.09.2022, 3), § 2 ja § 3 lg 1 ja 2, original text RT I, 24.09.2022, 3, in force from 21.11.2022

titles.en: Apply for an Eesti Pank account on its form with proof of legal status, powers and ownership

summaries.en: An Estonian credit institution, an Estonian branch of a foreign one or a credit institution being founded in Estonia applies for an account at Eesti Pank on the form on Eesti Pank's website, with documents proving its legal status and its representatives' powers. It supplies the further data Eesti Pank asks for on its legal status, its managers' powers, an ownership and control structure that lets the beneficial owners be identified, and the expected number, counterparties and purposes of its transactions through the account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use the Eesti Pank account only for its purposes and through authorised representatives, and report changes in them at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste kontode avamise ja kasutamise tingimused Eesti Pangas (Eesti Panga presidendi 22.09.2022 määrus nr 7, RT I, 24.09.2022, 3), § 5 lg 1, 3 ja 4, original text RT I, 24.09.2022, 3, in force from 21.11.2022

titles.en: Use the Eesti Pank account only for its purposes and through authorised representatives, and report changes in them at once

summaries.en: The institution may use the account only to hold euros, make payments, secure payment obligations and hold its minimum reserves, and only through representatives it has authorised or who represent it by law. When the representatives authorised to dispose of the account or the scope of their powers change, it gives Eesti Pank without delay all the data needed for the legal certainty of their dealings.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send Eesti Pank payment orders electronically with the required payer and payee details
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste kontode avamise ja kasutamise tingimused Eesti Pangas (Eesti Panga presidendi 22.09.2022 määrus nr 7, RT I, 24.09.2022, 3), § 6 lg 1 ja 3, original text RT I, 24.09.2022, 3, in force from 21.11.2022

titles.en: Send Eesti Pank payment orders electronically with the required payer and payee details

summaries.en: The institution gives its orders, payment orders included, to Eesti Pank electronically, and in another reliable written form only when electronic submission is temporarily blocked or too risky and Eesti Pank accepts that form. A payment order identifies at least the payer and payee by name and IBAN, the payer's identifying data, the payee's address, the amount and currency and the value date, with the purpose or reference and the intermediary's details where needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell Eesti Pank and return the money at once when the account is credited by mistake
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste kontode avamise ja kasutamise tingimused Eesti Pangas (Eesti Panga presidendi 22.09.2022 määrus nr 7, RT I, 24.09.2022, 3), § 10 lg 1, original text RT I, 24.09.2022, 3, in force from 21.11.2022

titles.en: Tell Eesti Pank and return the money at once when the account is credited by mistake

summaries.en: When Eesti Pank has credited the institution's account by mistake or without a legal basis, the institution informs Eesti Pank and returns the amount immediately after discovering the entry.

instruments.title: Add Maksejuhiste aktsepteerimise tingimused, the Governor of Eesti Pank's regulation on accepting payment orders (Eesti Panga presidendi 11.05.2010 määrus nr 4)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksejuhiste aktsepteerimise tingimused (Eesti Panga presidendi 11.05.2010 määrus nr 4), RTL 2010, 25, 446, original text RTL 2010, 25, 446, in force from 22.05.2010, issued by the Governor of Eesti Pank under Eesti Panga seadus § 2 lg 1, § 14 p 3 ja § 15 lg 3 ning Võlaõigusseadus § 709 lg 17, read through the gazette's own interface (its XML); entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Maksejuhiste aktsepteerimise tingimused
titles.en: Conditions for accepting payment orders

payload.officialRef: Maksejuhiste aktsepteerimise tingimused (RTL 2010, 25, 446)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report a payment order that does not clearly express the initiator's will by the next settlement day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksejuhiste aktsepteerimise tingimused (Eesti Panga presidendi 11.05.2010 määrus nr 4, RTL 2010, 25, 446), § 4 lg 2 ja § 5, original text RTL 2010, 25, 446, in force from 22.05.2010

titles.en: Report a payment order that does not clearly express the initiator's will by the next settlement day

summaries.en: A credit or financial institution licensed in Estonia that receives a payment order which does not clearly express the initiator's will, for instance because required data are missing or contradict each other, informs the initiator, or the initiator's institution or intermediary when it is not the initiator's own institution, by the next settlement day at the latest, unless the initiator has decided otherwise.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept a payment order when the agreed conditions are met, and return the funds at once when it is not accepted
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksejuhiste aktsepteerimise tingimused (Eesti Panga presidendi 11.05.2010 määrus nr 4, RTL 2010, 25, 446), § 6, original text RTL 2010, 25, 446, in force from 22.05.2010

titles.en: Accept a payment order when the agreed conditions are met, and return the funds at once when it is not accepted

summaries.en: The institution must accept a payment order delivered on the agreed terms when the funds for it have been provided, the fees have been agreed, the execution date lets the deadline be met and making the payment breaches no legal duty. Where it does not accept the order, it returns the funds handed over for it to the payer without delay, allowing the time reasonably needed for the repayment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pass payment orders along the chain without truncating or distorting their data
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksejuhiste aktsepteerimise tingimused (Eesti Panga presidendi 11.05.2010 määrus nr 4, RTL 2010, 25, 446), § 7, original text RTL 2010, 25, 446, in force from 22.05.2010

titles.en: Pass payment orders along the chain without truncating or distorting their data

summaries.en: When a credit or debit payment order passes between the payer's institution, intermediaries and the payee's institution, each passes it on so that all data needed to execute it reach every institution and intermediary without truncation or distortion, and the institution at the receiving end can tell its client who initiated the payment and for what purpose.

instruments.title: Add Investeerimisfondi statistilised aruanded, the Governor of Eesti Pank's regulation on investment fund statistical reports (Eesti Panga presidendi 24.06.2025 määrus nr 7)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi statistiliste aruannete koostamise nõuded ning aruannete esitamise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 24.06.2025 määrus nr 7), RT I, 02.07.2025, 1, original text RT I, 02.07.2025, 1, in force from 01.12.2025, issued by the Governor of Eesti Pank under Eesti Panga seadus § 34 lg 1, Article 5 of the ESCB Statute and Article 4 of Regulation (EC) No 2533/98, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 8 lg 1 of the regulation

titles.et: Investeerimisfondi statistiliste aruannete koostamise nõuded ning aruannete esitamise kord
titles.en: Requirements for drawing up investment fund statistical reports and the procedure for submitting them

payload.officialRef: Investeerimisfondi statistiliste aruannete koostamise nõuded ning aruannete esitamise kord (RT I, 02.07.2025, 1)
payload.implementsNote: Serves ECB Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 on securities holdings statistics (ECB/2012/24) and ECB Regulation (EU) 2024/1988 on investment fund statistics (ECB/2024/17), as § 1 lg 2 of the regulation states

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each non-public fund's investments, liabilities and units to Eesti Pank every month by the 15th
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi statistiliste aruannete koostamise nõuded ning aruannete esitamise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 24.06.2025 määrus nr 7, RT I, 02.07.2025, 1), § 2 lg 1, § 3 p 1–3, § 5 lg 1–3 ja 5 ja § 6 lg 2, original text RT I, 02.07.2025, 1, in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Report each non-public fund's investments, liabilities and units to Eesti Pank every month by the 15th

summaries.en: A management company of non-public investment funds, and a non-public fund set up as a public limited company, reports for each non-public fund its investments (code 580), its liabilities, fees and distributions (581) and its units, shares or stock (582) on the annexes, for each month by the 15th day of the following month; a fund company reports its units quarterly. A deadline that falls on a day off moves to the next working day.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the fund's characteristics once, by the 15th of the month after the reporting duty arises
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi statistiliste aruannete koostamise nõuded ning aruannete esitamise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 24.06.2025 määrus nr 7, RT I, 02.07.2025, 1), § 3 p 4, § 5 lg 4 ja § 6 lg 2, original text RT I, 02.07.2025, 1, in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: Report the fund's characteristics once, by the 15th of the month after the reporting duty arises

summaries.en: The report on the fund's characteristics (code 583) is submitted once, by the 15th day of the month after the reporting duty arises; funds that entered the reporting sample before 1 December 2025 submit it by 15 January 2026.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the fund statistics in XML, show matching identifiers on one line, correct errors and file empty reports
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi statistiliste aruannete koostamise nõuded ning aruannete esitamise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 24.06.2025 määrus nr 7, RT I, 02.07.2025, 1), § 4 lg 1 ja § 6 lg 1 ja 3–5, original text RT I, 02.07.2025, 1, in force from 01.12.2025

titles.en: File the fund statistics in XML, show matching identifiers on one line, correct errors and file empty reports

summaries.en: The reports are drawn up in monetary amounts, except the characteristics report, and go to Eesti Pank electronically as XML documents under Eesti Pank's regulation on electronic reporting, with values whose identifiers coincide shown on one line. Corrected reports follow when errors are found or accounting policies change, and an empty report is filed where there is no data.

instruments.title: Add Europangatähtede ja -müntide saatmine, the Governor of Eesti Pank's regulation on sending euro banknotes and coins to Eesti Pank (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.12.2010 määrus nr 24)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Europangatähtede ja -müntide Eesti Panka saatmise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.12.2010 määrus nr 24), RT I, 20.12.2010, 8, original text RT I, 20.12.2010, 8, in force from 01.01.2011, issued by the Governor of Eesti Pank under Eesti Panga seadus § 14 p 8 ja § 14¹ lg 3, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 2 of the regulation

titles.et: Europangatähtede ja -müntide Eesti Panka saatmise kord
titles.en: Procedure for sending euro banknotes and coins to Eesti Pank

payload.officialRef: Europangatähtede ja -müntide Eesti Panka saatmise kord (RT I, 20.12.2010, 8)
payload.implementsNote: Applies the ECB decision of 16 September 2010 on the authenticity and fitness checking and recirculation of euro banknotes, which annex 1 of the regulation names for unfit banknotes

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send Eesti Pank the unfit euro cash found in processing, packed apart from fit cash
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Europangatähtede ja -müntide Eesti Panka saatmise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.12.2010 määrus nr 24, RT I, 20.12.2010, 8), lisa 1 p 1.3, 3.9 ja 3.13, original text RT I, 20.12.2010, 8, in force from 01.01.2011, annex as the gazette publishes it with the text (EP24_lisa1.pdf)

titles.en: Send Eesti Pank the unfit euro cash found in processing, packed apart from fit cash

summaries.en: A credit institution sends Eesti Pank, for withdrawal from circulation, the unfit euro banknotes and coins that it or a cash handler it has authorised finds while processing cash, under the ECB decision of 16 September 2010, the rules and its contract with Eesti Pank. Unfit banknotes and coins travel packed separately from fit ones, with the block's label marked accordingly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pack euro banknotes and coins for Eesti Pank in the set bundles, blocks and bags with the required labels
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Europangatähtede ja -müntide Eesti Panka saatmise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.12.2010 määrus nr 24, RT I, 20.12.2010, 8), lisa 1 p 3.1–3.8, 3.10–3.12 ja 3.14, original text RT I, 20.12.2010, 8, in force from 01.01.2011, annex as the gazette publishes it with the text (EP24_lisa1.pdf)

titles.en: Pack euro banknotes and coins for Eesti Pank in the set bundles, blocks and bags with the required labels

summaries.en: Banknotes go in banded bundles of 100 of one denomination facing the same way, and ten bundles make a block, wrapped in film with an information label or bound between cardboard sheets with a header that shows the institution, the number and denomination of the notes, their total value, the packer and the date. Coins go in sealed bags of one denomination up to the quantities the rules set, labelled with the same kind of data, and any other packing needs Eesti Pank's permission.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept damaged euro cash from the public and send it to Eesti Pank for exchange with the holder's application
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Europangatähtede ja -müntide Eesti Panka saatmise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.12.2010 määrus nr 24, RT I, 20.12.2010, 8), lisa 2 p 2 ja 3, original text RT I, 20.12.2010, 8, in force from 01.01.2011, annex as the gazette publishes it with the text (EP24_lisa2.pdf)

titles.en: Accept damaged euro cash from the public and send it to Eesti Pank for exchange with the holder's application

summaries.en: A credit institution must accept damaged or mutilated euro banknotes and coins from legal and natural persons and send them to Eesti Pank for exchange in packaging that keeps them in the condition and quantity presented, each case packed separately, with the holder's completed application on the form annexed to the rules. Damaged cash that is also suspected of being counterfeit is handled as suspected counterfeit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send damaged euro cash found in processing to Eesti Pank separately with a covering letter
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Europangatähtede ja -müntide Eesti Panka saatmise kord (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.12.2010 määrus nr 24, RT I, 20.12.2010, 8), lisa 2 p 4 ja 5, original text RT I, 20.12.2010, 8, in force from 01.01.2011, annex as the gazette publishes it with the text (EP24_lisa2.pdf)

titles.en: Send damaged euro cash found in processing to Eesti Pank separately with a covering letter

summaries.en: Damaged or mutilated cash found while processing, such as a banknote missing more than a quarter of its size, taped together from more than two pieces or too damaged to authenticate or process, or coins whose value or authenticity cannot be told without laboratory tests, goes to Eesti Pank packed apart from fit and unfit cash. A covering letter lists the denominations and quantities and, where possible, the banknotes' serial numbers.

instruments.title: Add E-raha asutuste omavahendid ja aruanded, the Minister of Finance's regulation on e-money institutions' own funds and reports (Rahandusministri 05.09.2019 määrus nr 42)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, E-raha asutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 05.09.2019 määrus nr 42), RT I, 10.09.2019, 2, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 3, in force from 16.01.2023, issued by the Minister of Finance under Makseasutuste ja e-raha asutuste seadus § 65 lg 8 ja § 82 lg 5, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: E-raha asutuste omavahendite aruandluse kord, omavahendite minimaalsuuruse arvutamise põhimõtted ning Finantsinspektsioonile esitatavate aruannete skeemid, aruannete koostamise metoodika ja esitamise kord
titles.en: Own funds reporting of e-money institutions, principles for calculating minimum own funds, and the schemes, methodology and procedure of reports to Finantsinspektsioon

payload.officialRef: Rahandusministri 05.09.2019 määrus nr 42 (RT I, 10.09.2019, 2)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate own funds and minimum own funds by the Act's methods with the regulation's specific rules
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, E-raha asutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 05.09.2019 määrus nr 42, RT I, 10.09.2019, 2), § 2 ja § 6–10, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 3, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: Calculate own funds and minimum own funds by the Act's methods with the regulation's specific rules

summaries.en: An e-money institution licensed in Estonia calculates its own funds under the Payment Institutions and E-money Institutions Act, taking items at balance sheet value and applying the Act's limits, and its minimum own funds for issuing e-money under § 71(2) of the Act. Under the fixed overheads and the indicator methods it uses the last annual report approved by the general meeting, under the payment volume method it sums every payment transaction at its value, and under the indicator method it leaves out extraordinary income and insurance payouts, averages only the positive years and scales a short or long financial year to twelve months.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the six e-money institution reports to Finantsinspektsioon on the regulation's schemes
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, E-raha asutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 05.09.2019 määrus nr 42, RT I, 10.09.2019, 2), § 11 lg 1 ja § 12 lg 1–6, 9 ja 10, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 3, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: Submit the six e-money institution reports to Finantsinspektsioon on the regulation's schemes

summaries.en: An e-money institution that does not use the exemption in § 12 of the Act submits the reports on e-money issued and redeemed (code 5800), payment transactions (5801), client assets (5802), own funds (5803), balance sheet (5804) and income statement (5805) on the annexes. Amounts are in whole units and in euros, e-money at its nominal value and foreign currency at the ECB rate of the period's last working day, and the balance sheet and income statement follow the Estonian financial reporting standard or IFRS with the regulation's specific rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As an exempt e-money institution, submit the five reports for exempt institutions with every month filled in
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, E-raha asutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 05.09.2019 määrus nr 42, RT I, 10.09.2019, 2), § 11 lg 2 ja § 12 lg 7 ja 8, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 3, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: As an exempt e-money institution, submit the five reports for exempt institutions with every month filled in

summaries.en: An e-money institution using the exemption in § 12(1) of the Act submits the client assets report, the balance sheet and income statement, and the reports on its average outstanding e-money (code 5806) and on its payment transactions (5807). The last two show every calendar month, with zero where nothing was issued or no service was provided and for the months before the exemption licence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the minimum liability insurance where initiation or account information services are provided, and file all reports in XML
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, E-raha asutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 05.09.2019 määrus nr 42, RT I, 10.09.2019, 2), § 11 lg 3 ja § 13, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 3, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: Report the minimum liability insurance where initiation or account information services are provided, and file all reports in XML

summaries.en: An e-money institution providing payment initiation or account information services also submits the report on the minimum value of its professional liability insurance (code 5808). All reports go to Finantsinspektsioon electronically in XML under the technical requirements on its website, and a report with no data is submitted empty.

instruments.title: Add Makseasutuste vastutuskindlustus, the Minister of Finance's regulation on payment institutions' professional liability insurance (Rahandusministri 22.12.2017 määrus nr 104)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Makseasutuste vastutuskindlustus (Rahandusministri 22.12.2017 määrus nr 104), RT I, 23.12.2017, 53, original text RT I, 23.12.2017, 53, in force from 13.01.2018, issued by the Minister of Finance under Makseasutuste ja e-raha asutuste seadus § 63⁷ lg 4, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 10 of the regulation

titles.et: Makseasutuste vastutuskindlustuse kindlustussumma miinimumväärtuse arvutamise kord ja metoodika ning tagatise rakendamise tingimused
titles.en: Procedure and methodology for calculating the minimum sum insured of payment institutions' liability insurance and conditions for applying a guarantee

payload.officialRef: Makseasutuste vastutuskindlustuse kindlustussumma miinimumväärtuse arvutamise kord ja metoodika ning tagatise rakendamise tingimused (RT I, 23.12.2017, 53)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the minimum sum insured or guarantee every year as the sum of the risk, content and scale indicators
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Makseasutuste vastutuskindlustus (Rahandusministri 22.12.2017 määrus nr 104, RT I, 23.12.2017, 53), § 2, § 3 ja § 4, original text RT I, 23.12.2017, 53, in force from 13.01.2018

titles.en: Calculate the minimum sum insured or guarantee every year as the sum of the risk, content and scale indicators

summaries.en: A payment institution licensed in Estonia, or applying for a licence, that provides payment initiation or account information services, or both, calculates for each financial year, in euros, the minimum sum insured of its professional liability insurance or of an equivalent guarantee by adding up the indicators for its risks (claims made against it, payments initiated and accounts accessed), for the content of its services and for their scale. For a guarantee it also takes the guarantee's conditions into account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Compute each indicator in the regulation's bands, using licence forecasts and floors without twelve months of service
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Makseasutuste vastutuskindlustus (Rahandusministri 22.12.2017 määrus nr 104, RT I, 23.12.2017, 53), § 5–7, § 8 lg 4 ja 5 ja § 9, original text RT I, 23.12.2017, 53, in force from 13.01.2018

titles.en: Compute each indicator in the regulation's bands, using licence forecasts and floors without twelve months of service

summaries.en: Claims for losses made against the institution in the last 12 months count at their total, while the number of payments initiated, the number of accounts accessed, the value of payments initiated and the number of account information clients each count in descending bands from 40 down to 0.025 per cent. Services and activities other than payment services add 50,000 unless they are covered by an insurance or guarantee contract or provided through a separate subsidiary, and a firm that has not provided payment services in the preceding 12 months uses the forecasts in its licence application, each taken as at least 50,000.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Where both services are provided, calculate the minimum sum for each separately and cover them together
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Makseasutuste vastutuskindlustus (Rahandusministri 22.12.2017 määrus nr 104, RT I, 23.12.2017, 53), § 8 lg 1–3, original text RT I, 23.12.2017, 53, in force from 13.01.2018

titles.en: Where both services are provided, calculate the minimum sum for each separately and cover them together

summaries.en: A payment institution licensed for both payment initiation and account information services calculates the minimum sum insured for each service separately, and the content indicator is their combined total, which covers its liability for the losses named in § 63⁷(1) points 1 and 2 of the Act. Where it provides only one of the two services the content indicator is zero, and other payment services it provides are counted independently of the own funds methods.

instruments.title: Add Fondivalitseja aruanded, the Minister of Finance's regulation on management company reports to Finantsinspektsioon (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 12)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Fondivalitseja aruanded (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 12), RT I, 02.02.2017, 4, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 4, in force from 16.01.2023, issued by the Minister of Finance under Investeerimisfondide seadus § 334 lg 10 ja § 370 lg 9, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Finantsinspektsioonile esitatavate fondivalitseja aruannete sisu, koostamise alused ja esitamise ning fondivalitseja omavahendite aruandluse kord
titles.en: Content, basis and submission of management company reports to Finantsinspektsioon, and own funds reporting of management companies

payload.officialRef: Finantsinspektsioonile esitatavate fondivalitseja aruannete sisu, koostamise alused ja esitamise ning fondivalitseja omavahendite aruandluse kord (RT I, 02.02.2017, 4)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the management company's seven supervisory reports to Finantsinspektsioon in XML
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Fondivalitseja aruanded (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 12, RT I, 02.02.2017, 4), § 2, § 3 ja § 4, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 4, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: Submit the management company's seven supervisory reports to Finantsinspektsioon in XML

summaries.en: A management company licensed by Finantsinspektsioon under the Investment Funds Act, other than a small fund manager reporting under § 454 of the Act, submits its balance sheet (code 51), income statement (52), fee income report (521), assets under management report (513), own funds report (53), financial assets report (514) and fixed overheads report (522) on the annexes and their explanations. The reports go electronically in XML under the data security requirements on Finantsinspektsioon's website, and a report with no data is submitted empty.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare the reports in euros under Estonian GAAP or IFRS, keeping client assets off the balance sheet
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Fondivalitseja aruanded (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 12, RT I, 02.02.2017, 4), § 5, § 6 ja § 7, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 4, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: Prepare the reports in euros under Estonian GAAP or IFRS, keeping client assets off the balance sheet

summaries.en: The reports are in euros and whole units except where the annexes say otherwise, foreign currency converted at the ECB rate of the period's last working day; stock items show the end of the period and income items the year to date. The balance sheet and income statement follow Estonian good accounting practice or IFRS with the regulation's specific rules: client assets under management stay off the balance sheet, fair value changes go through profit or loss without a revaluation reserve, fixed overheads follow § 335 of the Act and any measurement Finantsinspektsioon has set applies.

instruments.title: Add Avalikustatavad fondi aruanded, the Minister of Finance's regulation on published fund reports (Rahandusministri 18.01.2017 määrus nr 8)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded avalikustamisele kuuluvate fondi aruannetele (Rahandusministri 18.01.2017 määrus nr 8), RT I, 20.01.2017, 11, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 13, in force from 07.09.2026, issued by the Minister of Finance under Investeerimisfondide seadus § 83 lg 7, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Nõuded avalikustamisele kuuluvate fondi aruannetele
titles.en: Requirements for fund reports subject to disclosure

payload.officialRef: Nõuded avalikustamisele kuuluvate fondi aruannetele (RT I, 20.01.2017, 11)
payload.implementsNote: Requires in UCITS and AIF reports the data of Section A of the annex to Regulation (EU) 2015/2365 on securities financing transactions and what Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 231/2013 requires, as § 9 of the regulation states

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare each public fund's annual and half-yearly report with accounts, an investment report and a transaction fee report under IFRS
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded avalikustamisele kuuluvate fondi aruannetele (Rahandusministri 18.01.2017 määrus nr 8, RT I, 20.01.2017, 11), § 1 lg 2 ja 3, § 2, § 3 ja § 4 lg 1 ja 2, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 13, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Prepare each public fund's annual and half-yearly report with accounts, an investment report and a transaction fee report under IFRS

summaries.en: For every public fund formed under the Investment Funds Act, pension funds and each sub-fund included, the annual and half-yearly report consists of the fund's accounts, its investment report and its transaction and brokerage fee report, prepared in euros under IFRS as adopted in the EU, taking account of the net asset value rules, with the precision of figures stated. A contractual fund's accounts include at least a balance sheet, an income statement, a statement of changes in net asset value and a cash flow statement, with the minimum items in annex 1.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show and explain any difference between the fund's net asset value and the net assets in its accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded avalikustamisele kuuluvate fondi aruannetele (Rahandusministri 18.01.2017 määrus nr 8, RT I, 20.01.2017, 11), § 5, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 13, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Show and explain any difference between the fund's net asset value and the net assets in its accounts

summaries.en: Where the net asset value calculated at the balance sheet date under the valuation regulation differs from the net assets attributable to unitholders or shareholders in the balance sheet, extra lines after the balance sheet show the difference and the notes explain its reasons. Where the difference also exists per unit or share, the net asset value per unit or share is disclosed for this and the previous period.

obligations.title: Add the duty: List every investment and its share of net asset value, and set apart securities whose price is not reliably observable
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded avalikustamisele kuuluvate fondi aruannetele (Rahandusministri 18.01.2017 määrus nr 8, RT I, 20.01.2017, 11), § 6 ja § 8, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 13, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: List every investment and its share of net asset value, and set apart securities whose price is not reliably observable

summaries.en: The investment report, on annex 2, shows all of the fund's investments and each one's share of its net asset value, and the transaction fee report follows annex 3. A UCITS sets apart the securities admitted to a regulated market, and other funds set apart securities that cannot be priced reliably from market prices, those valued by a system independent of the issuer and those whose price is constantly available to the market.

obligations.title: Add the duty: In a mandatory pension fund's investment report, disclose group-related and illiquid investments and how they are valued
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded avalikustamisele kuuluvate fondi aruannetele (Rahandusministri 18.01.2017 määrus nr 8, RT I, 20.01.2017, 11), § 7, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 13, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: In a mandatory pension fund's investment report, disclose group-related and illiquid investments and how they are valued

summaries.en: A mandatory pension fund's investment report also lists separately its investments in other funds of the same manager or group and in securities issued, underwritten or arranged by group companies or by companies in which the manager's managers or significant shareholders hold a significant stake, and sets apart fund investments by type, investments whose value changed materially and illiquid debt securities. For the illiquid debt securities it explains material value changes and write-downs over ten per cent under the manager's own method, the valuation method and the risk to the fund's assets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Add the securities financing and AIF disclosures to UCITS and AIF reports
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded avalikustamisele kuuluvate fondi aruannetele (Rahandusministri 18.01.2017 määrus nr 8, RT I, 20.01.2017, 11), § 9, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 13, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Add the securities financing and AIF disclosures to UCITS and AIF reports

summaries.en: Where a UCITS's or an AIF's investment policy provides for securities financing transactions, its report gives the data in Section A of the annex to Regulation (EU) 2015/2365. An AIF's report also carries what Delegated Regulation (EU) No 231/2013 requires, an activity report, the changes in the information given to investors and the remuneration the AIF manager paid during the year, in total and to staff whose work materially affects the fund's risk profile.

instruments.title: Add Krediidiandja ja -vahendaja aruanded, the Minister of Finance's regulation on the reports of credit providers and credit intermediaries (Rahandusministri 19.12.2015 määrus nr 50)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiandja ja -vahendaja aruanded (Rahandusministri 19.12.2015 määrus nr 50), RT I, 29.12.2015, 52, consolidated text RT I, 14.10.2025, 4, in force from 01.01.2026, issued by the Minister of Finance under Krediidiandjate ja -vahendajate seadus § 57 lg 5 ja Riikliku statistika seadus § 30¹ lg 3, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 7 of the regulation

titles.et: Finantsinspektsioonile esitatavate krediidiandja või -vahendaja ning välisriigi krediidiandja või -vahendaja filiaali aruannete vormid, koostamise metoodika ja esitamise kord
titles.en: Forms, methodology and submission of reports of credit providers and credit intermediaries and of Estonian branches of foreign ones to Finantsinspektsioon

payload.officialRef: Finantsinspektsioonile esitatavate krediidiandja või -vahendaja ning välisriigi krediidiandja või -vahendaja filiaali aruannete vormid, koostamise metoodika ja esitamise kord (RT I, 29.12.2015, 52)

obligations.title: Add the duty: As a credit provider, submit the balance sheet, income statement and consumer credit reports to Finantsinspektsioon
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiandja ja -vahendaja aruanded (Rahandusministri 19.12.2015 määrus nr 50, RT I, 29.12.2015, 52), § 2 lg 1 ja 3–5, consolidated text RT I, 14.10.2025, 4, in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: As a credit provider, submit the balance sheet, income statement and consumer credit reports to Finantsinspektsioon

summaries.en: A credit provider, or the Estonian branch of a foreign one, submits to Finantsinspektsioon its balance sheet (code 6101), income statement (6102), reports on the flows (6107) and balances (6108) of consumer credit issued in Estonia, its consumers report (6105), the report on consumer credit claims assigned or written off (6106) and the balances of consumer credit issued abroad (6109). A savings and loan association files its balance sheet and income statement through Eesti Pank, and a provider that is a payment institution follows the payment institutions' reporting regulation for those two reports.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As a credit intermediary, submit the balance sheet, income statement and the report on consumer credit intermediated
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiandja ja -vahendaja aruanded (Rahandusministri 19.12.2015 määrus nr 50, RT I, 29.12.2015, 52), § 2 lg 2 ja 3, consolidated text RT I, 14.10.2025, 4, in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: As a credit intermediary, submit the balance sheet, income statement and the report on consumer credit intermediated

summaries.en: A credit intermediary, or the Estonian branch of a foreign one, submits its balance sheet, its income statement and the report on the flows of consumer credit intermediated in Estonia (code 6110) to Finantsinspektsioon.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report other loans issued in Estonia to Eesti Pank through Finantsinspektsioon within a month
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiandja ja -vahendaja aruanded (Rahandusministri 19.12.2015 määrus nr 50, RT I, 29.12.2015, 52), § 2¹, consolidated text RT I, 14.10.2025, 4, in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Report other loans issued in Estonia to Eesti Pank through Finantsinspektsioon within a month

summaries.en: A credit provider also reports, through Finantsinspektsioon to Eesti Pank, the flows (code 6111) and balances (6112) of other loans issued in Estonia for each quarter within one month after it ends, unless it is a savings and loan association, reports leasing data to Eesti Pank under an agreement or has been exempted by Eesti Pank. A provider in a credit institution's consolidation group that does not report leasing under such an agreement also reports its consumer credit balances for the months that are not quarter ends and its other loans balances every month.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare the reports under Estonian GAAP or IFRS, file them in XML and correct any deficiency
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiandja ja -vahendaja aruanded (Rahandusministri 19.12.2015 määrus nr 50, RT I, 29.12.2015, 52), § 3, § 4 ja § 5, consolidated text RT I, 14.10.2025, 4, in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Prepare the reports under Estonian GAAP or IFRS, file them in XML and correct any deficiency

summaries.en: The reports are in the official currency and whole units, the balance sheet and income statement follow the Estonian financial reporting standard or IFRS with the regulation's specific rules, and the consumer credit reports leave out the contracts in § 403(2) of the Law of Obligations Act. They go electronically in XML under Finantsinspektsioon's technical requirements, an empty report is filed where there is no data, and a corrected report follows whenever a deficiency is found, by the authority or by the firm itself.

instruments.title: Add Pandikirjade tagatisregistri andmed, the Minister of Finance's regulation on the data entered in the covered bond cover register (Rahandusministri 11.11.2019 määrus nr 52)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjade tagatisregistrisse kantavate andmete koosseis (Rahandusministri 11.11.2019 määrus nr 52), RT I, 13.11.2019, 1, original text RT I, 13.11.2019, 1, in force from 16.11.2019, issued by the Minister of Finance under Pandikirjaseadus § 11 lg 8, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Pandikirjade tagatisregistrisse kantavate andmete koosseis
titles.en: Content of entries in the cover register of covered bonds

obligations.title: Add the duty: Log every entry and change in the cover register to the second and keep extracts available for past dates
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjade tagatisregistrisse kantavate andmete koosseis (Rahandusministri 11.11.2019 määrus nr 52, RT I, 13.11.2019, 1), § 2 ja § 3, original text RT I, 13.11.2019, 1, in force from 16.11.2019

titles.en: Log every entry and change in the cover register to the second and keep extracts available for past dates

summaries.en: A credit institution operating in Estonia that holds Finantsinspektsioon's additional licence to issue covered bonds ensures that its cover register shows when each entry was made, changed, deleted or otherwise processed, at least to the second, and that extracts can also be made for past points in time.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Enter the set data on each mortgage-backed credit in the cover register, one credit per entry
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjade tagatisregistrisse kantavate andmete koosseis (Rahandusministri 11.11.2019 määrus nr 52, RT I, 13.11.2019, 1), § 4 lg 1 ja 2, original text RT I, 13.11.2019, 1, in force from 16.11.2019

titles.en: Enter the set data on each mortgage-backed credit in the cover register, one credit per entry

summaries.en: For each credit secured by a mortgage that serves as cover, the register shows the borrower, the currency, the outstanding amount, the contract date and number, the property's land register or cadastral reference and address, its market value under the Covered Bonds Act and the valuation date, the mortgage amount and the name of the security right in the language of the property's country. Each entry covers a single credit with every property securing it, and a property securing several credits appears in each of their entries.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Enter the set data on public sector exposures, substitute assets and liquidity buffer assets
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjade tagatisregistrisse kantavate andmete koosseis (Rahandusministri 11.11.2019 määrus nr 52, RT I, 13.11.2019, 1), § 5 lg 1 ja § 7 lg 1, original text RT I, 13.11.2019, 1, in force from 16.11.2019

titles.en: Enter the set data on public sector exposures, substitute assets and liquidity buffer assets

summaries.en: For public sector debt used as cover the register shows the debtor or issuer, the contract or ISIN, the currency, the amount outstanding and any guarantee or collateral and its provider. For substitute assets, liquidity buffer assets and assets received to secure derivative claims it shows the debtor, deposit-taker or issuer, the contract, deposit or ISIN reference, the currency, the outstanding amount and remarks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Enter the set data on each derivative in the cover register
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjade tagatisregistrisse kantavate andmete koosseis (Rahandusministri 11.11.2019 määrus nr 52, RT I, 13.11.2019, 1), § 6 lg 1, original text RT I, 13.11.2019, 1, in force from 16.11.2019

titles.en: Enter the set data on each derivative in the cover register

summaries.en: For claims and liabilities under derivatives in the cover pool the register shows the instrument's name under its master agreement, the trade number or other identifier, the trade date, the start and end dates, the master agreement's date and number, the notional currencies and amounts, the fixed and floating rates and the net present value with its currency.

instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Aktsionäride üldkoosolekul esindajakonto omaja esindamiseks ühtse nimekirjana volituse andmise kord (Rahandusministri 21.03.2003 määrus nr 52), RTL 2003, 43, 625, consolidated text RT I, 29.03.2018, 19, in force from 01.04.2018, issued by the Minister of Finance under Väärtpaberite registri pidamise seadus § 6 lg 7, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Aktsionäride üldkoosolekul esindajakonto omaja esindamiseks ühtse nimekirjana volituse andmise kord

payload.officialRef: Aktsionäride üldkoosolekul esindajakonto omaja esindamiseks ühtse nimekirjana volituse andmise kord (RTL 2003, 43, 625)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the issuer a written single-list proxy for the clients who asked to vote, by the time of the general meeting
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Aktsionäride üldkoosolekul esindajakonto omaja esindamiseks ühtse nimekirjana volituse andmise kord (Rahandusministri 21.03.2003 määrus nr 52, RTL 2003, 43, 625), § 2 ja § 3 lg 1 ja 2, consolidated text RT I, 29.03.2018, 19, in force from 01.04.2018

titles.en: Give the issuer a written single-list proxy for the clients who asked to vote, by the time of the general meeting

summaries.en: A nominee account holder whose clients have asked, by the agreed deadline, to exercise shareholder rights at a general meeting gives the issuer that convened it a written proxy by the time the meeting is held. The proxy states its date, time and term, the issuer and the meeting, each requesting client or their representative with address and identification code, the ISIN and number of shares attributed to each, and the holder's confirmation that they may represent it for those shares.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide a certified Estonian translation of a foreign-language proxy on request, and amend the proxy when shares are sold
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Aktsionäride üldkoosolekul esindajakonto omaja esindamiseks ühtse nimekirjana volituse andmise kord (Rahandusministri 21.03.2003 määrus nr 52, RTL 2003, 43, 625), § 3 lg 3 ja 4, consolidated text RT I, 29.03.2018, 19, in force from 01.04.2018

titles.en: Provide a certified Estonian translation of a foreign-language proxy on request, and amend the proxy when shares are sold

summaries.en: Where the proxy is in a foreign language, the nominee account holder provides at the issuer's request an Estonian translation certified by a notary or a sworn translator. If shares named in the proxy are sold afterwards, it may give the issuer an amended proxy that reflects the change in the representatives' rights.

titles.et: Kindlustusmaakleri ja välisriigi kindlustusmaakleri Eesti filiaali aruannete sisu, vorm ja esitamise kord

payload.officialRef: Kindlustusmaakleri ja välisriigi kindlustusmaakleri Eesti filiaali aruannete sisu, vorm ja esitamise kord (RT I, 23.10.2015, 6)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the non-life, life and reinsurance contracts brokered for each half year and year within a month
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Kindlustusmaakleri ja välisriigi kindlustusmaakleri Eesti filiaali aruannete sisu, vorm ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 20.10.2015 määrus nr 38, RT I, 23.10.2015, 6), § 1 p 1–3, § 2 lg 1 ja § 3 lg 3 ja 5, consolidated text RT I, 09.12.2021, 14, in force from 01.01.2022

titles.en: Report the non-life, life and reinsurance contracts brokered for each half year and year within a month

summaries.en: An insurance broker, or the Estonian branch of a foreign one, reports to Finantsinspektsioon the non-life, life and reinsurance contracts it brokered, on annexes 1 to 3, for the first half of the calendar year and for the whole year, within one month after each period ends; a deadline falling on a day off moves to the next working day.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the year's total commission income by 31 July of the following year
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Kindlustusmaakleri ja välisriigi kindlustusmaakleri Eesti filiaali aruannete sisu, vorm ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 20.10.2015 määrus nr 38, RT I, 23.10.2015, 6), § 1 p 4, § 2 lg 2, § 3 lg 4 ja § 5, consolidated text RT I, 09.12.2021, 14, in force from 01.01.2022

titles.en: Report the year's total commission income by 31 July of the following year

summaries.en: Once a year, by 31 July of the following year, the broker reports its total commissions recognised as income (code 8250): a broker the amount in its annual income statement, a branch the amount recognised in its accounts for the calendar year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show brokered contracts by class and insurer at gross premium, and file the reports in XML
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Kindlustusmaakleri ja välisriigi kindlustusmaakleri Eesti filiaali aruannete sisu, vorm ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 20.10.2015 määrus nr 38, RT I, 23.10.2015, 6), § 3 lg 1, 2, 6 ja 7 ja § 4, consolidated text RT I, 09.12.2021, 14, in force from 01.01.2022

titles.en: Show brokered contracts by class and insurer at gross premium, and file the reports in XML

summaries.en: The reports show the number of contracts brokered in the period, their premiums gross of the broker's commission and the commissions received or receivable, by class of insurance and for each Estonian insurer and branch separately, with foreign insurers summed for the EEA and outside it, and leave out contracts brokered to another broker and the unpaid premiums of contracts cancelled in the same period. They go electronically in XML under Finantsinspektsioon's technical requirements, empty where there is no data and corrected when an error is found.

titles.en: Procedure for reporting quarterly contributions to the investor protection sub-fund

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the quarterly investor protection contribution to Finantsinspektsioon by the 20th of the following month
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse aruandluse kord (Rahandusministri 23.10.2002 määrus nr 123, RTL 2002, 121, 1764), § 1 lg 2, § 2, § 4 lg 1, 2 ja 2¹ ja § 5 lg 1, 2 ja 4, consolidated text RT I, 29.11.2018, 14, in force from 01.01.2019

titles.en: Report the quarterly investor protection contribution to Finantsinspektsioon by the 20th of the following month

summaries.en: Every investment institution within the meaning of § 43(1) of the Guarantee Fund Act, and each Estonian branch of a foreign one that the Act covers, draws up the contribution report in the annex for each quarter and submits it to Finantsinspektsioon electronically in XML under its published technical requirements, by the 20th day of the month after the quarter or the next working day. Its consolidation group is treated as a credit institution group where it includes a credit institution, otherwise as an investment firm group or as a group under the Commercial Code.

payload.refLabel: § 1 lg 2, § 2, § 4 lg 1, 2 ja 2¹ ja § 5 lg 1, 2 ja 4

obligations.title: Add the duty: Correct the contribution report when Finantsinspektsioon or the firm finds a deficiency
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse aruandluse kord (Rahandusministri 23.10.2002 määrus nr 123, RTL 2002, 121, 1764), § 4 lg 5, consolidated text RT I, 29.11.2018, 14, in force from 01.01.2019

titles.en: Correct the contribution report when Finantsinspektsioon or the firm finds a deficiency

summaries.en: When Finantsinspektsioon reports a deficiency in the contribution report, the institution remedies it and submits a corrected report; it does the same when it finds an error in data it submitted earlier or when the accounting policies of earlier periods have changed.
