titles.en: Procedure for calculating quarterly contributions to the investor protection sub-fund and for determining the value of investments

payload.officialRef: Investorikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse arvutamise ning investeeringu väärtuse määramise kord (RTL 2002, 121, 1762)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the quarterly contribution as the investment volumes times the Fund's rates, at least the statutory minimum
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse arvutamise ning investeeringu väärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 23.10.2002 määrus nr 121, RTL 2002, 121, 1762), § 1 lg 2 ja § 3 lg 1–4, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 12, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Calculate the quarterly contribution as the investment volumes times the Fund's rates, at least the statutory minimum

summaries.en: An investment institution, or a covered branch counting only its own figures, calculates its quarterly contribution by multiplying each investment volume under §§ 4 to 6 by the rate the Guarantee Fund's supervisory board has set and adding the results; where the total is below the minimum in § 53(4) of the Guarantee Fund Act, the contribution is that minimum. Figures of a foreign branch of an Estonian institution that the Act does not cover are left out.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Measure the trading volume as the average turnover of the quarter's last ten working days, leaving out the excluded trades
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse arvutamise ning investeeringu väärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 23.10.2002 määrus nr 121, RTL 2002, 121, 1762), § 4, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 12, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Measure the trading volume as the average turnover of the quarter's last ten working days, leaving out the excluded trades

summaries.en: For buying and selling securities the volume is the average daily turnover of the last ten working days of the preceding quarter, each trade counted at its purchase or sale price, or at the contract price when the institution intermediates. Trades with professional investors and with the persons in § 48(1) points 1 to 4 of the Act, derivatives other than option premiums, repos, securities lending, pledges, corporate actions and clients' trades in which the institution takes no part are left out.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Measure the portfolio management and custody volumes at market value on the quarter's last working day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse arvutamise ning investeeringu väärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 23.10.2002 määrus nr 121, RTL 2002, 121, 1762), § 3 lg 5, § 5 ja § 6, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 12, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Measure the portfolio management and custody volumes at market value on the quarter's last working day

summaries.en: For portfolio management the volume is the clients' cash at the institution's disposal and the market value of their securities on the last working day of the preceding quarter, without netting clients' liabilities; for custody it is the market value of the securities held on that day, at nominal value where no price is available. Both leave out the assets of professional investors and of the persons in § 48(1) points 1 to 4 of the Act and investments on central register accounts that the Fund does not cover; portfolio management also leaves out client deposits already contributing to the deposit guarantee sub-fund, and custody leaves out assets counted under portfolio management.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value investments mainly at market value under the regulation's rules and justify the calculations in writing on request
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse arvutamise ning investeeringu väärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 23.10.2002 määrus nr 121, RTL 2002, 121, 1762), § 3 lg 6, § 7 lg 1 ja 3, § 10 ja § 11, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 12, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Value investments mainly at market value under the regulation's rules and justify the calculations in writing on request

summaries.en: Investments are valued mainly at market value under chapter 3 of the regulation: a listed security at the closing price of the regulated market in the issuer's home country, with fallbacks when there is no recent trade, an unlisted one at its probable sale price set prudently, in good faith and in the clients' best interests, and a fund unit at its last redemption price or net asset value. At the request of the Guarantee Fund or Finantsinspektsioon the institution justifies its contribution calculations and valuation decisions in writing.

instruments.title: Add Väärtpaberite registri pidamise kord, the Minister of Finance's regulation on maintaining the securities register and the pension register (Rahandusministri 20.01.2018 määrus nr 7)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Väärtpaberite registri ja pensioniregistri pidamise kord (Rahandusministri 20.01.2018 määrus nr 7), RT I, 24.01.2018, 2, consolidated text RT I, 03.12.2021, 28, in force from 06.12.2021, issued by the Minister of Finance under Väärtpaberite registri pidamise seadus § 3 lg 5 ja § 8 lg 1, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Väärtpaberite registri ja pensioniregistri pidamise kord
titles.en: Procedure for maintaining the securities register and the pension register

payload.officialRef: Väärtpaberite registri ja pensioniregistri pidamise kord (RT I, 24.01.2018, 2)

obligations.title: Add the duty: As account operator, pass register orders to the registrar without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Väärtpaberite registri ja pensioniregistri pidamise kord (Rahandusministri 20.01.2018 määrus nr 7, RT I, 24.01.2018, 2), § 11 lg 1 ja 2, consolidated text RT I, 03.12.2021, 28, in force from 06.12.2021

titles.en: As account operator, pass register orders to the registrar without delay

summaries.en: An account operator gives the registrar the order for a register operation it has received from a person entitled to give it without delay after receiving it, unless the mandate set another time, following the timing, blocking and settlement rules of the Act, the regulation and the registrar's data processing rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: After losing or giving up account operator status, follow the registrar's instructions and archive order records for ten years
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Väärtpaberite registri ja pensioniregistri pidamise kord (Rahandusministri 20.01.2018 määrus nr 7, RT I, 24.01.2018, 2), § 17, consolidated text RT I, 03.12.2021, 28, in force from 06.12.2021

titles.en: After losing or giving up account operator status, follow the registrar's instructions and archive order records for ten years

summaries.en: A person whose account operator status has been revoked or who has given it up complies with the instructions and demands of the registrar or the pension registrar meant to protect account holders and the other operators. It archives the data and documents behind every order it was given so that they stay available to entitled persons and authorities for at least ten years from the revocation or from the end of its contract with the registrar.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Forward a nominee account application only for an eligible applicant, and as nominee holder report any deviation at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Väärtpaberite registri ja pensioniregistri pidamise kord (Rahandusministri 20.01.2018 määrus nr 7, RT I, 24.01.2018, 2), § 18, consolidated text RT I, 03.12.2021, 28, in force from 06.12.2021

titles.en: Forward a nominee account application only for an eligible applicant, and as nominee holder report any deviation at once

summaries.en: An account operator sends the registrar an application to open a nominee account only where the applicant meets the requirements of the Act and the regulation. A nominee account holder notifies the supervisor under § 38(1) of the Act, the registrar and the account operator without delay of any departure from the requirements that apply to it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As nominee account holder, disclose the client data the supervisor or the registrar requests within the set time
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Väärtpaberite registri ja pensioniregistri pidamise kord (Rahandusministri 20.01.2018 määrus nr 7, RT I, 24.01.2018, 2), § 19, consolidated text RT I, 03.12.2021, 28, in force from 06.12.2021

titles.en: As nominee account holder, disclose the client data the supervisor or the registrar requests within the set time

summaries.en: On a written or reproducible request of the supervisor or the registrar that names the security, the reference date and time, the clients concerned, the scope and form of the data and the way and deadline for delivery, the nominee account holder delivers the data in § 6(7) of the Act on those terms and within that deadline, which may not be shorter than three working days.

instruments.title: Add Investorile ja Tagatisfondile esitatavad andmed, the Minister of Finance's regulation on data for investors and the Guarantee Fund after an investor compensation event (Rahandusministri 15.08.2002 määrus nr 104)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorile ja Tagatisfondile esitatavate andmete loetelu ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 15.08.2002 määrus nr 104), RTL 2002, 93, 1455, original text RTL 2002, 93, 1455, in force from 31.08.2002, issued by the Minister of Finance under Tagatisfondi seadus § 57 lg 2, read through the gazette's own interface (its XML); entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Investorile ja Tagatisfondile esitatavate andmete loetelu ja esitamise kord
titles.en: List of data to be submitted to investors and the Guarantee Fund and the procedure for submitting it

payload.officialRef: Investorile ja Tagatisfondile esitatavate andmete loetelu ja esitamise kord (RTL 2002, 93, 1455)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send each investor the data on their investment within 45 days of the compensation day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorile ja Tagatisfondile esitatavate andmete loetelu ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 15.08.2002 määrus nr 104, RTL 2002, 93, 1455), § 1 ja § 3 lg 1, original text RTL 2002, 93, 1455, in force from 31.08.2002

titles.en: Send each investor the data on their investment within 45 days of the compensation day

summaries.en: When investor compensation is triggered, the management board member, bankruptcy or moratorium administrator or liquidator of an investment institution sends each investor, by post or e-mail to the contact address the institution knows, within 45 days after the compensation day, the investor's name and identification code, the compensation day, the value of the investment or of the investor's share in a joint investment on that day, its currency and compensable value, the legal ground where it is not covered, the investor's known bank account with the deadline to change or give it, and the deadline for the investor's position.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the Guarantee Fund the data on every investor and investment within 45 days of the compensation day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investorile ja Tagatisfondile esitatavate andmete loetelu ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 15.08.2002 määrus nr 104, RTL 2002, 93, 1455), § 2 ja § 3 lg 2, original text RTL 2002, 93, 1455, in force from 31.08.2002

titles.en: Give the Guarantee Fund the data on every investor and investment within 45 days of the compensation day

summaries.en: Within the same 45 days the management board member, administrator or liquidator gives the Guarantee Fund, in writing and in a form that can be reproduced in writing, the same data on each investor of the institution and their investment, with the investor's known contact address.

instruments.title: Add Hoiustaja teabeleht, the Minister of Finance's regulation on the depositor information sheet (Rahandusministri 09.03.2016 määrus nr 16)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Hoiustaja teabelehe andmekoosseis (Rahandusministri 09.03.2016 määrus nr 16), RT I, 11.03.2016, 11, original text RT I, 11.03.2016, 11, in force from 31.05.2016, issued by the Minister of Finance under Tagatisfondi seadus § 31 lg 1¹, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 4 of the regulation

titles.et: Hoiustaja teabelehe andmekoosseis
titles.en: Data set of the depositor information sheet

payload.officialRef: Hoiustaja teabelehe andmekoosseis (RT I, 11.03.2016, 11)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up the depositor information sheet on the regulation's template
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Hoiustaja teabelehe andmekoosseis (Rahandusministri 09.03.2016 määrus nr 16, RT I, 11.03.2016, 11), § 2, § 3 ja lisa, original text RT I, 11.03.2016, 11, in force from 31.05.2016, annex as the gazette publishes it with the text (RM_m16_lisa.pdf)

titles.en: Draw up the depositor information sheet on the regulation's template

summaries.en: Every credit institution founded in Estonia and every Estonian branch of a foreign credit institution draws up the information sheet it gives depositors on the template annexed to the regulation. The sheet names the institution and the deposit guarantee scheme protecting the deposits, states the cover of 100,000 euros per depositor per institution with all deposits at the same institution added together and the limit applying to each holder of a joint deposit, repayment within seven working days, the currency of repayment and the scheme's contacts and website, and leaves room for the depositor's acknowledgement of receipt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Complete the information sheet with the template's explanations that apply to the institution
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Hoiustaja teabelehe andmekoosseis (Rahandusministri 09.03.2016 määrus nr 16, RT I, 11.03.2016, 11), lisa p 1–5, original text RT I, 11.03.2016, 11, in force from 31.05.2016, annex as the gazette publishes it with the text (RM_m16_lisa.pdf)

titles.en: Complete the information sheet with the template's explanations that apply to the institution

summaries.en: Where they apply, the institution adds the template's explanations: that the deposit is covered by a contractual or institutional protection scheme recognised as a deposit guarantee scheme, the trade names it operates under with the same licence, how joint accounts and higher cover in certain cases work, the responsible scheme and its repayment period, and that it tells depositors on request whether a product is covered and confirms cover on account statements.

instruments.title: Add Pensionikaitse osafondi osamakse aruandlus, the Minister of Finance's regulation on reporting quarterly contributions to the pension protection sub-fund (Rahandusministri 27.05.2009 määrus nr 35)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pensionikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse aruandluse kord (Rahandusministri 27.05.2009 määrus nr 35), RTL 2009, 45, 624, consolidated text RT I, 29.11.2018, 16, in force from 01.01.2019, issued by the Minister of Finance under Tagatisfondi seadus § 92 lg 2, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Pensionikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse aruandluse kord
titles.en: Procedure for reporting quarterly contributions to the pension protection sub-fund

payload.officialRef: Pensionikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse aruandluse kord (RTL 2009, 45, 624)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the quarterly pension protection contribution to Finantsinspektsioon by the tenth day of the following month
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pensionikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse aruandluse kord (Rahandusministri 27.05.2009 määrus nr 35, RTL 2009, 45, 624), § 2 lg 1 ja 2, § 3, § 4 lg 1, 2 ja 4–6 ja § 6, consolidated text RT I, 29.11.2018, 16, in force from 01.01.2019

titles.en: Report the quarterly pension protection contribution to Finantsinspektsioon by the tenth day of the following month

summaries.en: A management company licensed to manage a mandatory pension fund, or the depositary that has taken over a fund's management, reports for each quarter, on report code 437 with the fund's code, the fund's net asset value at the end of the quarter, the contribution rate set by the Guarantee Fund's supervisory board as m/100 and the contribution, net asset value times rate, rounded to whole units. The report goes to Finantsinspektsioon in XML under its published technical requirements by the tenth calendar day of the following month, or the next working day, and is filed empty where there is no data.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Correct the pension protection contribution report when a deficiency is found
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pensionikaitse osafondi kvartaliosamakse aruandluse kord (Rahandusministri 27.05.2009 määrus nr 35, RTL 2009, 45, 624), § 5 lg 3, consolidated text RT I, 29.11.2018, 16, in force from 01.01.2019

titles.en: Correct the pension protection contribution report when a deficiency is found

summaries.en: When Finantsinspektsioon reports a deficiency, the reporting company remedies it and submits a corrected report, as it also does on finding an error in data it submitted earlier or when the accounting policies of earlier periods change.

instruments.title: Add Kohustuslike pensionifondide valitsemise aruanne, the Minister of Finance's regulation on the report on managing mandatory pension funds (Rahandusministri 13.01.2017 määrus nr 4)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Kohustuslike pensionifondide valitsemise aruande vormi ja selle täitmise juhendi kehtestamine (Rahandusministri 13.01.2017 määrus nr 4), RT I, 17.01.2017, 11, consolidated text RT I, 29.03.2018, 26, in force from 01.04.2018, issued by the Minister of Finance under Investeerimisfondide seadus § 374 lg 2, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Kohustuslike pensionifondide valitsemise aruande vormi ja selle täitmise juhendi kehtestamine
titles.en: Form of the report on managing mandatory pension funds and instructions for completing it

payload.officialRef: Kohustuslike pensionifondide valitsemise aruande vormi ja selle täitmise juhendi kehtestamine (RT I, 17.01.2017, 11)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include the report on managing mandatory pension funds in the notes to the annual accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Kohustuslike pensionifondide valitsemise aruande vormi ja selle täitmise juhendi kehtestamine (Rahandusministri 13.01.2017 määrus nr 4, RT I, 17.01.2017, 11), § 2 lg 1 ja 4 ja § 3 lg 1, consolidated text RT I, 29.03.2018, 26, in force from 01.04.2018

titles.en: Include the report on managing mandatory pension funds in the notes to the annual accounts

summaries.en: A manager of mandatory pension funds presents, in the notes to its annual accounts, the report on managing mandatory pension funds on the scheme and item explanations in the regulation's annex, for reporting periods beginning on or after 1 January 2017.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Match the report's income and costs to the income statement and explain how costs are allocated
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Kohustuslike pensionifondide valitsemise aruande vormi ja selle täitmise juhendi kehtestamine (Rahandusministri 13.01.2017 määrus nr 4, RT I, 17.01.2017, 11), § 2 lg 2 ja 3, consolidated text RT I, 29.03.2018, 26, in force from 01.04.2018

titles.en: Match the report's income and costs to the income statement and explain how costs are allocated

summaries.en: The income and costs of managing mandatory pension funds in the report agree with those in the manager's income statement, costs are split between managing those funds and the manager's other activities on the principles in its internal rules, and the report ends with an explanation of those principles.

instruments.title: Add Fondi likvideerimisaruanne, the Minister of Finance's regulation on the liquidation report of a fund (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 10)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded fondi likvideerimisaruandele (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 10), RT I, 02.02.2017, 2, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 2, in force from 05.02.2017, issued by the Minister of Finance under Investeerimisfondide seadus § 179 lg 3, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Nõuded fondi likvideerimisaruandele
titles.en: Requirements for the liquidation report of a fund

payload.officialRef: Nõuded fondi likvideerimisaruandele (RT I, 02.02.2017, 2)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report to Finantsinspektsioon after a fund's liquidation with the data and documents the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded fondi likvideerimisaruandele (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 10, RT I, 02.02.2017, 2), § 1, § 2 ja § 3, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 2, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Report to Finantsinspektsioon after a fund's liquidation with the data and documents the regulation lists

summaries.en: Once the liquidation of a contractual fund, a sub-fund or a fund set up as a public limited company has ended, the liquidation report to Finantsinspektsioon gives the fund, its manager, depositary and liquidators, the liquidation decision and its publication, the fund's assets on the decision day and at the start of liquidation (net asset value, units, value per unit and a list of every asset), its liabilities and how they were met, transactions with its assets, the distribution notice, court rulings and the key dates. Where the depositary or liquidators appointed by Finantsinspektsioon complete the liquidation, the report adds when it passed to them and the assets at that time, and a pension fund's report adds the manager's account of handing over its management.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Detail each creditor's claim, each liquidation cost and each payout to investors in the liquidation report
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded fondi likvideerimisaruandele (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 10, RT I, 02.02.2017, 2), § 4, § 5 ja § 6, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 2, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Detail each creditor's claim, each liquidation cost and each payout to investors in the liquidation report

summaries.en: The report names each creditor with the size, origin, ground and settlement of the claim and any deposit of money, shows unsettled management and depositary fees separately, gives each liquidation cost's type, size, ground and timing with, for a contractual fund, their total and share of net asset value, and lists each payment or asset handed over or deposited for every unitholder or shareholder.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the liquidation report approved and signed by a management board member or the liquidators
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded fondi likvideerimisaruandele (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 10, RT I, 02.02.2017, 2), § 7, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 2, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Have the liquidation report approved and signed by a management board member or the liquidators

summaries.en: A management board member of the management company approves a contractual fund's liquidation report, unless the law or its articles say otherwise; the liquidators approve jointly the report of a fund company or of a liquidation they completed on Finantsinspektsioon's appointment, and a management board member of the depositary approves it where the depositary completed the liquidation. The approval carries each approver's name, signature and date.
